item.title: Which English cheese can’t be made in its namesake village? The Saturday quiz
item.summary: From lover, soldier, justice, pantaloon and second childishness to George W Bush describing ‘some weird shit’, test your knowledge with the Saturday quiz 1 Which English cheese cannot be made in its namesake village? 2 What did George W Bush reportedly describe in January 2017 as “some weird shit”? 3 What is the UK’s only aquatic songbird? 4 In the church year, what is Ordinary Time? 5 Clara Rockmore was a virtuoso on what electronic instrument? 6 Which actor injured his achilles tendon while playing Achilles? 7 Carting Lane, off the Strand, has London’s last type of what lamp? 8 Which 1980 TV docudrama caused a crisis in Anglo-Saudi relations?
